text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, see you all tomorrow. 
Goodbye~.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact & Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Goodbye—. 
Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Daring Tact! 
Are you free tomorrow~?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... It's a rest day, 
so I didn't have any particular plans 
scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! Then make them with us, Daring 
Tact! 
—Valentine's chocolates♡

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The ingredients have arrived!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
We've got chocolate, toppings... 
plenty to go around. 
Let's get cracking and make a ton of them!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
“Love it, love it, full steam ahead! 
Valentine's is right around the corner~♪”

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower, Win Marilyn, 
and Marche Lorraine too... 
Are we all making chocolates together 
today?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
“That's right~! 
Nishino Flower is gonna be our teacher 
so we can make the perfect chocolates!”

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
“I wanna give something super special 
to my dearest Loves Only You~☆”

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Totally get it♡ I want Big Sis and 
Cheval Grand to shower me with compliments 
too! 
Like, 'Look at you go!'♪

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, everyone has someone special in 
mind, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Win Marilyn, do you have someone 
you wish to give chocolates to as well?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Rather than that... think of it as part of 
getting into character. 
I've rarely experienced events where girls 
our age have fun 
together like this, so I came all the way 
from Miho♪

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Daring Tact? 
What brought you here?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Well, Vivlos invited me...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...so I just sort of drifted along.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. 
Everyone, huddle up!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Let's start off with a little counseling 
session 
for Daring Tact.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, Daring Tact, 
what did you usually do for Valentine's 
before now?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Well... 
I never really paid much attention to it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I think I might have visited someone's 
home 
and had chocolate cake there, or something 
along those lines...?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
“Whoa! So today might be your very first 
real Valentine's mission?! 
Eek, how thrilling☆”

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh~ Listen up, okay? 
Valentine's is suuuper, crazy important!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You convey your feelings to someone 
special through chocolate! 
The chocolate part is super crucial♪ 
Probably!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ......Teacher Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Um... well, chocolate is something 
that so many people love, so... 
in that sense, chocolate might be 
important too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, what matters most is probably... 
the feelings you want to convey.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Why do you want to give it to them? 
How do you want them to feel when they get 
it...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If you put your heart into making it like 
that, 
anything you make turns out delicious.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower... 
...Somehow, you look so dazzling right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Totally! Nishino Flower must have someone 
who makes her feel that way, huh~♪"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
What, really?! Who, who?! 
Tell me, tell me!!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Hey, come on, we're talking about Daring 
Tact right now!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
So to sum it up... 
should we start with who you're giving it 
to? 
Assuming there's someone you want to give 
it to, that is.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I want to give it to Trainer. 
My Valentine's gift!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower, would you mind giving me 
some advice about chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Of course! 
Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Marche, wasn't Daring Tact like, 
suuuuuper dazzling just now?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"She was suuuuuper dazzling, wasn't she?! 
And with such an earnest gaze, too... 
Daring Tact is hyper-sincere...!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One evening, I received a message from 
Daring Tact 
and headed to the designated spot—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! 
Happy Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Together with some friends, 
I tried making chocolate cups.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
With a forest in mind, 
I sprinkled matcha and other ingredients 
over them. 
I hope they bring you a sense of 
refreshment.
choice_data_list:
Thank you so much for going out of your 
way...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...When I thought about who I wanted to 
give something to, 
you were the very first person who came to 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I wanted the person who is always by my 
side, supporting me, 
to feel happy and cheerful...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad we have such a wonderful 
occasion as Valentine's! 
Thank you, always.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Touched by Daring Tact's kindness, 
it turned into a truly heartwarming 
Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! 
Happy Valentine's Day!
choice_data_list: Thank you...! And wow, that's huge!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It is. Actually... 
this is a nut chocolate cake!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I didn't want it to be just any 
ordinary chocolate cake— 
I wanted it to feel like me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
When I asked if we could make something 
fitting for Valentine's 
using nuts and berries... Nishino Flower 
came up with 
a wonderful recipe for me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It was difficult since it's winter, but... 
I gathered winter berries 
and dried preserved nuts from wherever I 
could find them—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And somehow, I managed to bring out 
my ideal flavor!
choice_data_list: You really put so much care into this...
You really put so much care into this...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Of course. After all... 
it's for you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's is an occasion where you 
convey your feelings 
to someone special through chocolate...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, your face 
immediately came to mind!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I always want you to feel fulfilled, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So that neither your stomach nor your 
heart 
will ever go hungry. 
If anything happens, I will always be 
there to help you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I baked it with those feelings in mind. 
Please accept it, if you would.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: You're very welcome!
